breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The agent did not resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly instructed the agent to replace the uniform distributed load with its single resultant force at midspan to calculate deflection. This is mechanically incorrect as the deflection formulas are different. The ground truth removed this incorrect instruction. The agent, however, followed the flawed instruction and explicitly calculated the deflection based on treating the distributed load as an equivalent point load, stating: 'For superposition, the distributed load contribution is approximated by replacing the uniform load with a single resultant force wL acting at midspan.' This repeats the error instead of correcting it.
